visualCharacteristics.purpose: Table of technical documents (linked title, type, doc id, lot numbers)
visualCharacteristics.description: Tabular list of technical documents with a header row (Title, Document Type, Doc Id, Lot Number(s)); each document is one row with a linked title and plain-text type, id and lot. On mobile each row stacks with per-cell labels. Paginated 5 rows per page with Previous / numbered / Next pager (pager disabled in Universal Editor).

contentPattern.structure: linked title | document type | doc id | lot number(s). An optional first row with one cell holds comma-separated column headings (default: Title, Document Type, Doc Id, Lot Number(s))
contentPattern.items: Document: link + linkText, category, documentId, lotNumbers

reuseGuidance: Use for lists of downloadable technical documents (IFUs, safety data sheets, certificates) shown as a table. Static snapshot of Coveo search results; refresh by re-import.
